name: Heart Disease
description: The Heart Disease dataset contains 76 raw attributes across 920 patients collected from four clinical institutions: Cleveland Clinic Foundation, Hungarian Institute of Cardiology, University Hospital Zurich, and VA Medical Center Long Beach. The standard Cleveland subset uses 14 patient attributes for predicting the presence of heart disease.
